Method of Attack: roots devices and infects Zygote, a core Android OS process, making removal almost impossible without wiping the device
pre-installed malware on low-cost Android smartphones
injection of trojan via third-party code added into system libraries before compilation
Impacted Systems: over 40 models of low-cost Android smartphones from brands such as Leagoo, Doogee, Vertex, Advan, Cherry Mobile, and others; Android devices globally including Russia, Poland, Indonesia, China, Czech Republic, Mexico, Kazakhstan, Serbia
Attack Vector: pre-installed malware on newly shipped devices
software developer from Shanghai injecting trojan into system images and libraries
